title: Burning City Quarter
name: scene_burning_quarter
scene_summary: A wide cobbled city street on fire: burning houses on both sides, a toppled waggon spilling sacks and crates across the stones, a small square with a stone fountain that is the one place not yet alight, and the city gate closing the street at the south end.
render_details: Grey cobbles wet with spilled oil, charred timber and splintered planks, smashed carts, burst barrels, orange flame licking out of window openings, thick black smoke, drifting embers, soot-blackened stone, clean water in a carved basin, heavy timber gates bound with iron

rooms.label: Stone House
rooms.description: The ground floor of a two-storey stone house on the west side of the street, still standing and still whole, its rooms full of overturned furniture and fallen plaster, with the fire raging in the storey above it.

rooms.label: Fountain Square
rooms.description: A small open square of cobbles on the east side, with a carved stone fountain standing in the middle of it still full of clean water. Nothing here is burning yet and the stones are clear enough to fight on.

rooms.label: Burning Street
rooms.description: A wide cobbled street running the length of the map, littered with charred beams, splintered planking, smashed carts and burst barrels, with patches of the cobbles already alight and spilled oil running between the stones.

annotations.label: Toppled Waggon
annotations.description: A big four-wheeled waggon lying over on its side in the middle of the street, its load of sacks and timber crates spilled out across the cobbles around it and a slick of dark oil spreading from underneath it

annotations.label: Stone Fountain
annotations.description: A carved stone fountain standing in the middle of the square, its basin full of clean clear water, the cobbles around it wet and completely free of fire

annotations.label: Burning Gallery
annotations.description: A ruined timber gallery bridging the gap between two buildings on the north side, well alight along its whole length, its boards burnt through in places and burning fragments fallen on the ground beneath it

annotations.label: City Gate
annotations.description: A pair of great timber city gates bound with iron closing the south end of the street, set in a thick stone gatehouse wall, one leaf standing part open

annotations.label: Fallen Beam
annotations.description: A massive burning timber beam fallen right across the street, blocking it from one side to the other, flame running along its whole length and the cobbles scorched black beneath it

annotations.label: Spilled Masonry
annotations.description: A heap of fallen masonry and charred timber spilled across the street where the wall of a building has come down, spread flat over the cobbles and still smoking

annotations.label: Burning Cobbles
annotations.description: A stretch of cobbles running with burning oil, low flame spread flat across the stones rather than rising from anything standing on them
